parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, but a current documented assault pattern (45 incidents in two months), influencer incitement, victim-blaming police, no discrimination law, and an anti-LGBT bill promised — hostility with thin recourse, hitting trans-feminine people hardest.

Strong visitor-facing machinery: X markers, pioneer recognition law, marriage equality, functioning courts and care access. Offset by record 2025 hate-crime year, activists describing community vulnerability as chaotic, abolished equality agency and a non-applied gender-motivated aggravator.

Dead-letter sodomy statute with no prosecutions, impersonation offence repealed, an embedded third-gender tradition holding chiefly titles, and documented social tolerance of trans people. Custody and border practice remain open questions, keeping it below acceptance-plus-working-protection tiers.

Constitutional equality, decriminalisation and courts granting relief, but documented traveler-facing friction: airport identity stops, passport medical exams, railway-police gender checks and degrading custody, plus a new criminal code stripped of trans sexual-violence safeguards.

All sex outside marriage criminalised with flogging and documented executions; morality raids with threat of execution, official advisory barring trans people from busy areas, ID cards exposing trans status, custodial rape, recognition only via surgery, no protections at all.
